tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Bornean Orangutan adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 CHEER: Small pleased celebration lifting the two existing forelimbs/wings/fins comfortably, same supported body and scale. Do not jump or enlarge. Species constraints: 尾を新設しない。既存の丸い指表現・腕の長さを守り、胸をたたく激しい演技や過大な人の手へ変えない。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states.
